entities.name: Aerojaunt Field
entities.description: A hexagonal practice field at Strixhaven dedicated to magical aerial activities, used by less competitive and intramural teams.

entities.name: Intramural Silkball Club
entities.description: A club that especially likes to practice and play silkball at Aerojaunt Field.

entities.name: Strixhaven Stadium
entities.description: A newer sports facility that superseded Aerojaunt Field.

events.summary: Aerojaunt Field, once the university's main sports field, was superseded by newer facilities but remains popular for silkball.
events.quote: Once the university's main sports field, it has since been superseded by newer facilities

relations.note: The club especially uses the field to practice and play silkball.
relations.quote: it remains popular for practicing and playing silkball, especially among the Intramural Silkball Club
